summary: Thailand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs rejected a statement by UN Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews regarding human rights and border displacement, asserting that Bangkok did not initiate the border conflict and that hostilities resulted from Cambodian attacks targeting civilian areas in Thailand.
title: Thailand rejects UN special rapporteur's statement on human rights situation in Cambodia

summary: An analysis highlights that ceasefires between Cambodia and Thailand remain fragile without clear border demarcation, outlining Phnom Penh's strategy utilizing bilateral talks, legal action, and international mediation.
title: Cambodia and Thailand must define the border to achieve lasting peace

summary: Thailand has issued a strong rebuttal against comments by UN Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews regarding his visit to Cambodia, where he stated that 20,000 displaced people remain unable to return home due to Thai military presence.
title: Thailand hits back at 'inaccuracies' in UN expert's Cambodia findings

summary: Stratfor reports that Thailand and Cambodia continue to maintain a fragile ceasefire despite recent landmine explosions along the border in Sisaket and Sa Kaeo provinces that injured Thai soldiers. The Thai military described the incidents as accidents without blaming Cambodia, but stalled boundary disputes continue to pose risks of escalation.
title: Thailand and Cambodia Maintain an Uneasy Ceasefire

summary: Cambodia filed a notice under UNCLOS for compulsory conciliation of its maritime border dispute with Thailand over energy-rich areas in the Gulf of Thailand, following Thailand's cancellation of a 2001 bilateral memorandum of understanding.
title: Cambodia files notice with UN to force conciliation of maritime sea border dispute with Thailand

summary: The Thai government terminated a 2001 Memorandum of Understanding with Cambodia regarding joint development and boundary delimitation in overlapping maritime claims in the Gulf of Thailand after two decades of stalled negotiations.
title: Thailand scraps stalled maritime territory deal with Cambodia

summary: Thailand's Joint Information Center has urged the public to read a newly released white paper compiling historical evidence, facts, and international law regarding the border dispute.
title: JIC urges Thais to read white paper on Cambodia border

summary: Thailand expects the chair of a five-member conciliation commission addressing its maritime boundary dispute with Cambodia under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea to be selected on August 14, with its first meeting expected in September.
title: Thailand expects Unclos panel chair on August 14

summary: Thailand called for dialogue and the use of agreed bilateral mechanisms to address border issues with Cambodia, rejecting unilateral claims and threats.
title: Thailand urges dialogue over Cambodia border tensions

summary: Policy strategist Pansak Vinyaratn and economist Ky Sereyvath discussed the severe humanitarian and economic costs of the prolonged border conflict on both nations.
title: Thai analyst and Cambodian economist debate economic toll of border conflict on both sides

summary: Cambodia lodged a strong protest against Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's unauthorized visit to the An Seh area in Preah Vihear province, calling it an attempt to legitimize territorial claims.
title: Cambodia protests Thai PM's visit to disputed border area, calls it bid to legitimise alleged occupation
